description:
【High-Power 5000W Peak Motor】this M7 electric motorcycle boasts a 5000W peak motor that delivers robust performance, accelerating to a max speed of 43MPH instantly, empowering you to tackle urban roads and off-road paths with ease, mastering 30° slopes instantly with a twist of the throttle for exhilarating off-road fun.
【UL-Certified High-Capacity Battery】: Equipped with an advanced BMS and UL-certified 60V/27AH rechargeable battery, providing reliable power supply for extended rides while ensuring safe charging and long-term durability, delivering up to 31 miles of range for extended adventures, with reliable, safe charging every time.
【All-Terrain Puncture-Resistant Tires】: Features 14"/12" all-terrain tires with puncture-resistant design, offering excellent grip and stability on various surfaces—from smooth city streets to rough off-road trails. It’s also paired with a 200mm-travel front hydraulic fork ensures stable, consistent damping for smooth rides on tough terrain.
【Full Hydraulic Brakes & Suspensions】Comes with full hydraulic brakes and suspensions, delivering precise, powerful stopping performance and smooth damping, ensuring a comfortable and safe ride even on bumpy terrain. Advanced EABS + hydraulic disc brakes deliver powerful, precise stopping—even on dusty or muddy trails—for steady, confident control on every ride.
【Versatile & Reliable Design】Engineered for both urban commuting and light off-roading, combining high performance, durability, and safety to meet all your riding needs with confidence.Tips: please fill in your recipient's contact number when placing an order to match the policy of large items’ shipment.
